builders.name: snap_send_session_hello
builders.summary: Builds the session open/register handshake: derives+stores the session key at conn+0x4c (FUN_001c3ab0), emits selector(0,2) with two config strings and a capability/flags byte, transmits, advances to state 0x36.

builders.name: build_packet_header
builders.summary: Builds the 8-byte tx header at obj+0x28: type byte param_3 (0x01/0x02/0x10), length-derived bytes from DAT_002484c0/510 tables, and an auto-incrementing sequence (obj+0x3d) for reliable types; resets payload length obj+0x38.

builders.name: snap_req_op01_session_open
builders.summary: SN@P RPC stub: sends app opcode 0x01 carrying three 32-bit config words (likely session-open/login params), returns result.

builders.name: send_op01_to_conn
builders.summary: Builds a 0x8000-reliable packet with app-opcode 0x01 + payload and sends it to a specific decoded connID target.

builders.name: build_req_op01
builders.summary: Builds a txn record with opcode 0x01 subtype 1 for the current room payload, stamps seq byte, who-byte 0; sets pending kind=1.

builders.name: build_req_op01_sub2
builders.summary: Builds an opcode 0x01 subtype 2 txn record for the current room, copies who-bytes; if FUN_005df7b0(room) reports not-ready sets state 6 with error class 0x124=2.

builders.name: build_packet_header
builders.summary: Builds the 8-byte tx header at obj+0x28: type byte param_3 (0x01/0x02/0x10), length-derived bytes from DAT_002484c0/510 tables, and an auto-incrementing sequence (obj+0x3d) for reliable types; resets payload length obj+0x38.

builders.name: snap_send_close
builders.summary: Sends a zero-length reliable opcode-2 message (session close/bye) when conn+0x50c lock is clear; sets errno 0x65/0x66 on alloc/send fail.

builders.name: snap_close
builders.summary: Public session-close wrapper: validates param_1==1/conn!=0 then delegates to snap_send_close(conn).

builders.name: snap_req_op02
builders.summary: SN@P RPC stub: sends app opcode 0x02 with empty body (likely session close/status), returns result.

builders.name: send_op02
builders.summary: Builds and sends a 4-byte reliable app-opcode 0x02 packet to the target.

parsers_handlers.name: register_snap_message_handlers
parsers_handlers.summary: Registers the overlay's SN@P message handlers on the connection handle (0x6febac) via func_0x001d4d24(handle, code, addr): binds codes 0xd/0xe/0xb->name-reply, 3/7->area count, 0x13->in-room subdispatch, 0x15/4/5/2/6/8/10 to their handlers.

builders.name: snap_send_op03
builders.summary: Builds/sends a reliable (who 0xb000) opcode-3 message carrying a 16-byte blob (param_2 copied via FUN_00109eb8); completion cb 0x1d, seq counter conn+0x614.

builders.name: send_op03
builders.summary: Builds and sends a 4-byte reliable app-opcode 0x03 packet to the target conn (roster-sync step).

builders.name: room_roster_sync_sm
builders.summary: Room create/enter roster-sync state machine (phases in cRam006cbb90): builds member list from candidate table, waits for accepts, then broadcasts op03/05/06/07/08/09 to sync every member and fires completion cb.

builders.name: build_req_op03
builders.summary: Builds a txn record opcode 0x03 subtype 1 for the current room payload, stamps seq, then FUN_005d6a10(record+0x108,1,1) to register a slot; sets pending kind=2.

parsers_handlers.name: snap_app_msg_dispatch
parsers_handlers.summary: Received-app-message sub-dispatcher: reads who-byte (conn+0x2c) reliable/set/DATA bits and 7-bit selector (conn+0x2e), byteswaps fields, then switches on (selector-3) to the per-type app callback in the conn+0x548..0x610 table (rooms/roster/chat/menus), including nested sub-selector routing for types 0x24/0x25/0x26.

parsers_handlers.name: register_snap_message_handlers
parsers_handlers.summary: Registers the overlay's SN@P message handlers on the connection handle (0x6febac) via func_0x001d4d24(handle, code, addr): binds codes 0xd/0xe/0xb->name-reply, 3/7->area count, 0x13->in-room subdispatch, 0x15/4/5/2/6/8/10 to their handlers.

builders.name: libsnap_send_op04_create_slot
builders.summary: Channel 0x2000, alloc tag 4, reliable send FUN_001cce80 (offline FUN_001a1750) with tmpl 0x24cc50/0x24cc60/0x24cc80 (uRam0034357a); parses the reply into 0x3ce350 and sets list ptr 0x3ce30c.

builders.name: snap_send_op05_data
builders.summary: Builds/sends reliable (who 0xb000) opcode-4 with a single htonl u32 payload (create-slot / room id); completion cb 0x1e, seq conn+0x615.

builders.name: snap_send_create_room
builders.summary: Builds/sends reliable opcode-4 with a 0x2c-byte struct: name (FUN_00109eb8), a packed 16-bit field, optional string (+0x14), and two more packed shorts/u32; completion cb 0x1f, seq conn+0x616.

builders.name: send_op04_create_slot
builders.summary: Builds and sends the reliable app-opcode 0x04 create-slot packet (full 0x304-byte body) to the target.

builders.name: build_req_enter_or_create
builders.summary: Builds a txn-queue record for the current room: opcode 0x06 (enter, if the looked-up room is the current one, state=5) else 0x04 (create-slot, state=3), subtype 1, copying who-bytes 0x108/0x109 from the room.

builders.name: session_enter_dispatch
builders.summary: Given a request key and subtype, finds/creates a session-pool node (0x4f370): for enter/create (4/5) checks slot via FUN_005d6a50, for 6 rejects if occupied, else allocates a fresh session node (evicting the oldest) and sets its state to 3 (in-progress).

builders.name: snap_send_op05_or_finalize
builders.summary: If create-in-progress flag set, finalizes/errors the session; otherwise builds and sends an op-0x05 packet.

builders.name: snap_send_op05
builders.summary: Builds/sends opcode-5 with a single htonl u32, who 0xa000 (reliable set, no DATA bit); completion cb 0x20, seq conn+0x617.

builders.name: send_op05
builders.summary: Builds and sends a reliable app-opcode 0x05 packet with a 2-byte payload (slot idx + count) to the target.

builders.name: room_roster_sync_sm
builders.summary: Room create/enter roster-sync state machine (phases in cRam006cbb90): builds member list from candidate table, waits for accepts, then broadcasts op03/05/06/07/08/09 to sync every member and fires completion cb.

builders.name: build_req_enter_or_prev
builders.summary: Like build_req_enter_or_create but using the reverse room iterator (FUN_005d6810): opcode 0x06/state5 if current, else opcode 0x05/state4, subtype 1.

builders.name: libsnap_send_op06_member_join
builders.summary: Sends the op06 member JOIN/enter: channel (toggle*0x80+0x1800), alloc tag 6, opens reliable send FUN_001cce80 with packed (p3|p1<<16|p2<<8) and marks member flags at 0x4de3e0; offline path calls FUN_001a0eb0.

builders.name: snap_send_join
builders.summary: Builds/sends reliable (who 0xb000) opcode-6 with a single htonl u32 (room id) — member JOIN/enter; completion cb 0x21, seq conn+0x618.

builders.name: snap_send_join_named
builders.summary: Builds/sends reliable opcode-6 (len 0x14): htonl u32 (room id) + optional 16-byte string (password/name); completion cb 0x21, seq conn+0x618.

builders.name: snap_send_op06_var
builders.summary: Builds/sends opcode-6 (len 0x18, who 0xa000): two htonl u32 + optional string; completion cb 0x22, seq conn+0x619.

builders.name: snap_req_op06_join
builders.summary: SN@P RPC stub: sends app opcode 0x06 (member join/enter) with no body, returns reply result word.

builders.name: roomjoin_state2_enter
builders.summary: Join phase 2: full enter-room flow — builds list/prompt widgets, checks slot availability (+0x43c), handles the join handshake and password/retry sub-widgets (0x5b45f0/47a0).

builders.name: send_op06_member_join

builders.summary: Per-frame handler for a room/lobby screen state: processes the queued net result via FUN_005cc980 and, on the right pad+flag combo, sends op06 (member enter/join) or advances/ tears down the screen.

builders.name: inroom_member_tick
builders.summary: State-8 (in-room) tick: on pad+phase==1 sends op06 and advances to state 9, otherwise runs the roster-fill pass (FUN_005cce30) and the room timeout tick (FUN_005cd1d0).

builders.name: snap_send_op0e_flush

builders.name: snap_send_op0f_request

builders.name: snap_send_op0f_reliable

builders.name: snap_send_op0f_unrel

builders.name: snap_send_op0f_data

builders.name: send_op0f_bare

builders.name: snap_send_op10_multi_ptr

builders.name: snap_send_op10_roominfo

builders.name: snap_recv_op12_data
